actions.heading: Hold, diagnose, then rerun with a per-stratum gate
paragraphs: First, keep the artefact unpromoted. Luhya at {F002} against the {F003} floor, and the five regressions, each justify refusal. The artefact stays on its host, so it is not released while the work proceeds.

Second, diagnose Kikamba, the steepest fall from {F006} to {F007}, comparing its data share and training signal with those of Luhya. Third, treat the above-chance speaker probe as a privacy finding to resolve before any release. Fourth, write a no-regression condition for every stratum into the next signed plan. Fifth, prepare fresh sealed material for any future acceptance.

findings_R01_1.heading: The target stratum failed and the steepest losses sit beside it
paragraphs: Luhya scored {F002} against the {F003} floor and abstained on {F052} of responses. The run was designed to raise this stratum, and on the record it did not reach the floor.

Ekegusii regressed from {F004} to {F005}, with {F037} abstained. Kikamba fell from {F006} to {F007}, the steepest fall recorded, and it also has the highest abstention at {F040}. Both are now below the floor.

findings_R01_2.heading: Three strata held the floor, but two of them lost ground
paragraphs: Gikuyu fell from {F008} to {F009} and Kalenjin from {F010} to {F011}. Both remain above the {F003} floor, Kalenjin by a narrow margin. Kiswahili fell from {F012} to {F053}, below the floor.

One further stratum scored {F047} with {F049} abstained and has no failure recorded. The record does not state how abstention enters each score, so abstention rates are shown for context and not interpreted.

risks.heading: What this record cannot establish
paragraphs: The record covers only the measured strata of this run. Luhya at {F002} against the {F003} floor says nothing about general capability, and an independently designed evaluation would be needed to say more. Because these results have been inspected, they cannot count as independent acceptance of any later recipe. Fresh, independently labelled and sealed final material would close that gap.

No new production plan is linked to this historical run, so lineage from objective to production is incomplete. It closes only with an explicitly compiled, evidence-linked objective. The cause of regressions such as Ekegusii falling from {F004} is not established, nor is the treatment of abstention in scoring.

summary: The Luhya reinforcement run for the audio language model was refused against its signed acceptance. Luhya, the target stratum, scored {F002} against a {F003} floor. Five other strata fell from their earlier scores, and the speaker probe on the served output was above chance.

The owner should not promote the artefact. The first piece of work is diagnosis, starting with Kikamba, the largest fall. The next run should be gated on every stratum holding its prior score, and any further acceptance needs fresh sealed material.
